originalFrozenTask.learnerTask: See how a larger search changes the probability of at least one false rejection under explicit independence.
originalFrozenTask.gap: No visualization locates the family of tests or separates selected findings from all tests.
originalFrozenTask.accuracyGuardrails: State the toy independence/null assumptions for family-wise calculations. At least one false rejection, false-discovery rate and probability that an individual finding is false are distinct quantities.
